clips.title: The story
paras: Steelsnap is a hunting task issued by Melor Stonehoof on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff. The hunt departs from traditional tauren reasons for killing, seeking the destruction of a vicious hyena whose pack terrorizes the wildlife of Thousand Needles.

Tauren tradition dictates that taking a life must serve a sacred or practical purpose: hunting for sustenance, hunting to uphold honor, or hunting to glean wisdom from the Earthmother. Melor Stonehoof offers this quarry as an exception to the rule. Steelsnap is viewed as an abomination against natural balance—a brutal tyrant that sows senseless violence and fear rather than maintaining the cycle of life.

Steelsnap roams the canyons of northern Thousand Needles, lingering south of the centaur enclave at Camp E'thok. Unlike solitary scavengers, this formidable beast draws fierce packmates into his wake, orchestrating attacks that disrupt and cull the more docile wildlife of the canyon floor. Slaying him and retrieving his rib cleanses the needles of his vicious influence.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: At times we hunt for food. At times we hunt for honor. And at times we hunt to earn the Earthmother's teachings.
But the hunt I now set upon you is none of these things. It is to slay a creature outside the Earthmother's blessing.
The hyena Steelsnap roams the Thousand Needles, south of the Barrens. He is a tyrant, attracting other hyenas to him and spreading fear and bloodshed among more peaceful beasts.
Find Steelsnap, friend. Find him, and defeat him.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you defeated the foul Steelsnap, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: In defeating the creature Steelsnap, you have cleansed the Thousand Needles of a horrible taint.
And that, friend, is your lesson this day.
